title: Robust Scenario-Based Data-Enabled Predictive Control of a Battery Energy Storage System: An Experimental Study
summary: Battery energy storage systems must respect strict state-of-charge (SOC) limits to prevent overcharge and deep discharge, a task complicated by measurement noise and costly-to-model nonlinear dynamics. Data-enabled predictive control (DeePC) resolves the costly modeling issue by predicting future behavior directly from data. However, its regularization robustifies only the prediction and not the constraints.
